'''Sana Ashraf''' is a man from [[Mat Cauthon]]'s memories.

== History ==
Mat remembers fighting him at the [[Falls of Pena]] and used heavy cavalry, horseback archers, heavy cavalry and horseback archers, one after another.{{ref/book|14|37}}
== Trivia ==
* Sana Ashraf is named for Sana Salman Ashraf, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
